svg.title: Where the pages of the website come from
svg.desc: The parts of the README become the pages Get started, How it works, Configuration, Reference, Help and the quick start of the home page. The hook of the website makes every comment of What reporters see from the functions and texts of issue_assistant.py, and the tables of the inputs and outputs on the Reference from action.yml. Every page gets a description of its own, from its front matter or its first paragraph.
